name: Misty
text: What is it that you are searching for?

name: You
text: I'm searching for my cat.. his name was Billoo

name: Misty
text: Ahh.. I saw him once, I am not sure where he is but.. I can help

name: Misty
text: Bring me five sun petals, and you will find your dearest Billoo

name: Misty
text: it's that flower behind you, bring me five of them
